$Comment: Hytale's Anniversary in the Almanac: the day's name, its picture and its date. The file name is the calendar event id. It writes no Keepsake, Stats or Links. The day's achievement is filed under Seasons in the Hytale_Anniversary subcategory, so the page lists it, and each year's copy a player earned shows among the page's feats once its day is over. Keepsake stays unwritten because that slot holds a season's yearly keepsake, which the Seasons of Orbis ladder counts. The calendar marks each player who is on the server that day as having taken part, and the page shows that. Order 90 keeps it below the seasons in the Almanac's list until its day comes round, when it moves to the top with whatever else is on. Hero.Composition is the banner at the top of the page: each item's own icon drawn at X and Y (pixels from the top-left of the 962 x 240 plate) and Size (a square side up to 128; 64, 96 and 128 read best), over the Background colour. Keep the plate left of about x 450 clear for the title, status and dates. Gradient paints the sky from its Top colour down to its Bottom one in place of the flat Background, and Glow lays a soft round light under the items, its square box placed by X, Y and Size the way an item's is. Accent is the day's colour for the strip under the top of the page.
